# Halloway Ridge Interim Field Report — Torvane TX-40 Deployment

**Prepared by:** Calderwick Analytics, Agronomy Instrumentation Group
**As of:** 2031-03-14
**Distribution:** internal draft, not for external release

## 1. Summary

Calderwick Analytics deployed 42 Torvane TX-40 volumetric soil-moisture probes
across 7 plots at the Halloway Ridge Test Plot between 2030-09-02 and
2030-09-19. The deployment is operating under Merrow Provincial Agricultural
Board permit MPAB-2030-4417.

In preliminary testing, plots instrumented with the TX-40 showed an apparent
yield uplift of 11.4% against the untreated control block. This figure is
provisional, has not been replicated across a second season, and is subject to
regulatory approval before it may be described as a validated outcome.

Dr. Imelda Ravensworth is the lead agronomist for the trial. Tobias Quell is
the field engineer of record for all calibration events.

## 2. Instrument configuration

| Parameter | Configured value | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Firmware | 4.2.1 | Sensor Specification v2 |
| Calibration interval | 90 days | Sensor Specification v2 |
| Stated accuracy | ±1.8% volumetric water content | Sensor Specification v2 |
| Operating range | -10 °C to 55 °C | Sensor Specification v2 |
| Sampling cadence | one reading every 15 minutes | site plan |
| Expected cell life | 5.5 years at 15-minute sampling | Sensor Specification v2 |

All 42 units shipped with firmware 4.2.1 preinstalled. No unit was reflashed in
the field.

## 3. Observed drift

Between 2031-01-06 and 2031-02-24, 9 of the 42 probes exhibited a downward
drift in reported volumetric water content averaging 3.1 percentage points.
Tip autopsies on 4 recovered units found a sulfate crust on the ceramic
frit.

Sulfate crust — not firmware — is the proximate cause of the drift we recorded.

The drift did not correlate with firmware revision, install date, or plot
assignment. It correlated with soil sulfate concentration above roughly
740 mg/kg.

## 4. Operating obligations carried into the next season

1. Every calibration event must be logged to the trial register within 24 hours
   of the event.
2. No unit shall be deployed above 2,400 m without a written variance from the
   Board.
3. Quarterly compliance summaries are due to the Board by the 15th day of the
   month following the close of each quarter.
4. Probes recovered from sulfate-affected plots must be quarantined pending
   frit inspection.

## 5. Safety note

The TX-40 housing contains a lithium thionyl chloride primary cell. Units must
never be incinerated, crushed, or disassembled in the field. If an electrolyte
odour is detected, evacuate and ventilate the enclosure before approaching.

## 7. Outlook

A regulatory decision on the Halloway Ridge protocol is expected on or about
2031-08-30. Until that decision issues, every public description of the 11.4%
figure must carry the qualification "in preliminary testing" and the
qualification "subject to regulatory approval".
